definitions.explanation: The seventh sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly September 23 to October 23. Also the constellation Libra. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{天秤座|てんびんざ}だ。
{天秤座|てんびんざ}の{人|ひと}はバランス{感覚|かんかく}にすぐれているそうだ。
examples.english: Libra people are said to have an excellent sense of balance.

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}の{天秤座|てんびんざ}は、{人間|にんげん}{関係|かんけい}でうれしいことがありそうだと{書|か}いてあった。
examples.english: It said this week's Libra is likely to have something pleasant happen in relationships.

notes:
The zodiac sign Libra, for people born from late September to late October.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天秤座|てんびんざ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Libra
- {天秤座|てんびんざ}{生|う}まれ: born a Libra
- {天秤座|てんびんざ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Libra horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
